meta.description: Build high-quality Agent Skills for Claude following official Anthropic best practices. Covers SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, description writing, progressive disclosure, testing, patterns, troubleshooting, and distribution across all surfaces (Claude.ai, Claude Code, API, Agent SDK).
